hulls.name: MV Konkan (illustrative)
hulls.subject: SUEZ
learned: The 72 h claim horizon understated the closure by 81 h; persistence beyond a chokepoint claim needs its own model.
The baseline exposure 0.85 scored a Brier of 0.0225 against a strait that was closed on arrival.
keep_plan would have cost 148 h against the recommended slow_steam's 179 h.
keep_plan: predicted 32 h, realised 148 h (+116 h).
slow_steam: predicted 38 h, realised 179 h (+141 h).
